# ButtonGroup

Buttons that belong together, with consistent spacing and a name for assistive technology.

```tsx
import { ButtonGroup } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- For two or more related actions, or a set of toggles such as chips.

## When not to

- For unrelated buttons that happen to be close.
- As a toolbar with arrow-key navigation: a toolbar is a different pattern.

## Examples

### Related actions

The group has a name. Put the primary action first or last, consistently across the product.

```tsx
<ButtonGroup label="Acciones de la inscripción">
  <Button>Inscribirme</Button>
  <Button variant="soft">Guardar para después</Button>
  <IconButton Icon={IconClose} label="Descartar" variant="outline" />
</ButtonGroup>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Names the group for screen readers ("Acciones del texto"). |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Role:** `group` with a required `aria-label`, so screen readers announce what the buttons share.
- Tab order follows the DOM; each button keeps its own focus ring.
- Wraps instead of overflowing on narrow screens.

## Content

- Name the group by what it does: "Acciones de la inscripción".
